title: Inline student claim review on crew rows
eyebrow: Web · Wisconsin Creative · Event detail Crew
lede: Staff and Admins should see who has claimed an open Student slot or a posted trade on the crew row itself, then review Approve or Decline without leaving Event detail.

sections.heading: After-only
sections.note: No trustworthy matched pair. The checkout already carried Event authoring and crew dirty work, and no isolated baseline was captured before this slice. After captures: after-crew-row.png (Ben Xiong’s claim on the first Video Student slot) and after-review-popover.png (Admin Approve/Decline popover). Role: ADMIN on Preview Football vs Eastern Michigan. Live claim was opened, not approved or declined.

changes.h: Pending claims lived only on Trade Board queues
changes.was: Event detail crew showed an empty Assign control. Admins had to leave for Trade Board to see who claimed the slot.
changes.now: The working-copy crew row shows an avatar group of claimants and a Review popover with Approve/Decline. Multiple students on one slot stack as a group; approving one declines the rest.

changes.h: Claimed trades were a badge, not a face
changes.was: Schedule students saw Trade claimed without a claimant avatar. Staff crew rows had no inline trade request.
changes.now: A claimed trade attaches the claimant to the assigned row with the same Review popover.

verification: 41 focused tests across crew-pending-review, schedule-working-copy-editor, rebase, history, call-window-validation, route-source, and claim-surfaces-source.
ESLint on the changed web files passed with --max-warnings=0.
TypeScript still fails only on the unrelated src/lib/services/blasts.ts payload typing.

Authenticated Preview Event detail for Football vs Eastern Michigan: working-copy GET returned pendingClaims for Ben Xiong; the first Video Student row showed Review 1 claim; the popover listed Ben Xiong with Approve and Decline. The live claim was not mutated.
npm run build:app was not run: 127.0.0.1:3000 is occupied by the existing Preview gear-tracker dev server.
notes: Student shift-group reads still return only the viewer’s own pending request. Staff can see claimants without approve permission. Review is blocked while unpublished crew edits exist because live approve/decline already refuse a working copy.
No live shift currently has multiple claimants, so the stacked avatar-group overflow is source-tested rather than screenshot-proven. No claimed trades were waiting on Preview during this pass.
Native iOS Event detail still uses the viewer’s own pendingStudentClaimShifts list and was not changed in this slice.
